newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Mob try to lynch Colombian priest killer.
newsitem.headline: Mob try to lynch Colombian priest killer.

text.p: An angry mob came close to lynching an 18-year-old drug addict after he stabbed to death a Roman Catholic priest in Colombia's violent northwest city of Medellin, police said on Friday.

A police spokesman said David Alejandro Vanegas Londono was on the verge of being beaten to death or hanged late on Thursday after residents of the working-class district of Campoamor discovered he had just killed a popular parish priest identified as Luis Eduardo Garcia Ciro.

The youth, who apparently killed the priest after he refused to lend him money for drugs, was plucked to safety by police, although Garcia Ciro managed to stab him with a screwdriver before succumbing to his own injuries, the spokesman said.
Medellin, Colombia's murder capital and one of the most violent cities in the world, boasts an average of more than 13 homicides a day, according to National Police statistics.
